need: A statement of what KIND of range each band is, and of what is not being claimed
point_argument: A determinate answer exists and does not need a range, because the answer is a VOCABULARY rather than a measurement. gen/dataio.py declares five range kinds; the two that are ICH terms of art - proven_acceptable_range and design_space - are deliberately EMPTY and no row in this repository claims either. That emptiness is the justified point: nothing here has been 'demonstrated to provide assurance of quality' and nothing was characterised by us, so claiming either term would be an over-claim of exactly the kind Q-053 guards against in the instrument register. SRC-ICH-QA-R5 chapter 2.1 shows that ICH contemplates different aspects of one process being described by different kinds of range, verbatim: 'The applicant may elect to use proven acceptable ranges or design space for different aspects of the manufacturing process.' BE PRECISE ABOUT WHAT THAT DOES AND DOES NOT LICENSE, because the first version of this row overstated it: that sentence answers whether a set of proven acceptable ranges is itself a design space, and it licenses electing between TWO ICH constructs. It says nothing about adding three of our own. The three project-coined kinds - evidence, argued, design_intent - are OURS, are labelled as ours in gen/dataio.py, and are defensible on their own terms precisely because they make no regulatory claim; they are not licensed by that clause and are not presented as though they were.
notes: DIRECT ANCHOR, and the only row in this checklist where ICH speaks to exactly the thing being done. s2.4.5 verbatim: 'A combination of proven acceptable ranges does not constitute a design space.' That sentence is why the stack of bands in this repository is never presented as one. The glossary supplies the other half, verbatim: a proven acceptable range is characterised 'while keeping other parameters constant', i.e. univariate BY DEFINITION - which is also why couplings.csv exists, since a set of univariate bands cannot express a corner that two parameters make unreachable together.

need: A discussion of impurities the enzymatic reaction itself introduces
notes: DIRECT ANCHOR, same clause as IN-007: 'the possibility of specific impurities from the reaction to the final substance should be discussed.' PARTLY ANSWERED, AND BY ARGUMENT RATHER THAN MEASUREMENT. The reaction-specific impurity is identified in exactly this chemistry - the adenylylated dead end, observed as the [+AMP] by-product - and the argument that it cannot be cleared downstream is a sound one from its mass difference of about 329 Da. What cannot be supplied is a QUANTITY: the species can be detected and identified but not quantified against a specification, because no reference standard exists and the deconvolution runs in a matrix supplying 100 mM potassium and 10 mM magnesium straight into the adduct envelope. One correction worth recording: mass RESOLUTION is not the barrier - 329 Da on a 14 kDa duplex needs a resolving power of about 43, which is trivial - so any claim that the instrument cannot see it should be struck, while C-007's statement that no control is defined must not be softened.

need: An acceptance criterion for residual enzyme protein in the drug substance
notes: GENERIC ANCHOR of a particular kind: the clause is precise and quotable but it is written for products that ARE proteins. s6.2.1(c) verbatim: 'Downstream-derived impurities include, but are not limited to, enzymes, chemical and biochemical processing reagents ..., inorganic salts ..., solvents, carriers, ligands ..., and other leachables.' So ICH's taxonomy does classify a residual ligase - and an immobilised carrier's leachate - as process-related impurities, which is why the immobilised branch changes the species list rather than escaping the duty. NOT KNOWABLE: no limit exists. The EU oligonucleotide guideline omits protein entirely ('protein' occurs zero times in all 27 pages) and the thresholds it offers are small-molecule routes, leaving only its own verbatim fallback, 'be toxicologically qualified'. The frequently quoted USP '<1 to 100 ng/mg' band is REFUSED here: it is a protein impurity in a protein product, and ours is the inverted case (Q-060).

need: A demonstration that the process clears the residual enzyme
notes: READ THE ANCHOR PRECISELY, BECAUSE THE OBVIOUS READING IS WRONG AND WOULD FLATTER US. s6.2.1(a) does license a substitution, verbatim: 'Clearance studies, which could include spiking experiments at the laboratory scale, to demonstrate the removal of cell substrate-derived impurities such as nucleic acids and host cell proteins may sometimes be used to eliminate the need for establishing acceptance criteria for these impurities.' But it sits in sub-paragraph (a), CELL SUBSTRATE-DERIVED, and a deliberately added ligase is a (c) impurity; sub-paragraph (c) carries no equivalent licence. So the argument shape a chromatography-free route needs is an ARGUMENT BY ANALOGY THIS PROJECT WOULD HAVE TO DEFEND, not an ICH permission, and it is written in exactly those terms. NOT KNOWABLE: no log-reduction figure exists for either branch. Worse, size-based ultrafiltration cannot supply one - the enzymes are 2.0 to 5.4 times the product mass against a rule of thumb demanding tenfold, so a membrane chosen to retain the duplex retains the ligase harder. That is 0 log, and it is the point at which the filtration-only thesis needs a different mechanism: proteolysis first would MANUFACTURE the mass gap, at the cost of making the protease the next residual protein.

need: The composition of the reaction buffer
point_argument: A recipe is not a variable, so a range would be a category error: the composition is a determinate set of charges and it is stated verbatim in a source this register already marked read in full - 50 mM Tris-HCl at pH 7.5, 100 mM KCl, 10 mM MgCl2 and 1 mM DTT. The one component that IS a variable, ATP, is excluded from this point and carried separately, because its value is contested (IN-006, Q-040). That split is the justification: what is fixed is given as a point, what is contested is given as a coupling.

need: Hold-time limits on the aqueous intermediates around this step
notes: DIRECT ANCHOR, and it is a DEFAULT rather than data: s4.1.5 sets an expectation that filtration times longer than 24 hours be justified, which tells you when you must supply evidence and supplies none itself. NOT KNOWABLE: no published hold-time study exists for any oligonucleotide process, and none for a ligation buffer at 2-8 C. The ambient guidance that exists is on mammalian cell culture and is hedged, so it is not transferred here as a band. THE COLD ENDPOINT STAYS BLANK RATHER THAN BEING EXTRAPOLATED FROM THE AMBIENT ONE, and one finding sharpens what the decision actually is: 2-8 C is not a no-growth condition. Cardinal minimum growth temperatures are 4 C for Bacillus cereus, Bacillus subtilis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa and 7 C for Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus, so at 2-4 C nothing in that panel grows while at 8 C most of it does. The real question is therefore whether the setpoint is below 4 C, not whether there is a chilled hold. And the verifying test cannot gate the decision in any case - compendial incubation is 3-7 days against a unit operation of under a day - so any limit must be prospective (R-009, R-020).

need: Bioburden and endotoxin expectations applying at this step
notes: DIRECT ANCHOR but the wrong end of the range, which is the trap this row records. The compendial ceiling for a non-sterile substance is 2000 TAMC and 200 TYMC CFU per g or mL; the oligonucleotide literature and the regulator both operate three to four orders BELOW that, at 0.1 to 1 CFU/mL, so quoting the compendial number as the oligonucleotide limit quotes the floor as though it were the target and sizes nothing. NOT KNOWABLE for the drug substance: the limits for an approved siRNA demonstrably EXIST - an EPAR names both tests in the active-substance specification, and on stability - but the numbers are commercially confidential rather than absent, which is a different kind of gap and maps onto the register's 'redacted' access value (Q-037). The endotoxin limit cannot be derived either, because the dose-based calculation needs a dose nobody has published for this molecule. AN UNREGISTERED COST FALLS OUT OF THE bioburden rule: a 0.1 CFU/mL limit demands a 100 mL sample, which at P-CONC-LIG removes about 1.5 g of product and is a real aseptic open operation.

need: Parameters expressed in a form that survives a change of scale
notes: DIRECT ANCHOR, quotable and UNCONDITIONAL - and it is re-anchored as of 2026-09-25, because the clause this row first cited does not bind us. ICH Q11 section 4 states, verbatim: 'Scaling factors should be included for manufacturing steps intended to span multiple operational scales when the process step is scale dependent.' Ours are scale dependent, so the requirement reaches us directly. WHAT WAS WRONG BEFORE: this row cited ICH Q8(R2) s2.4.4, whose shear-rate sentence is the more vivid illustration - 'if a product was determined to be shear sensitive in a mixing operation, the design space could include shear rate, rather than agitation rate' - but that section is titled 'Relationship of Design Space to Scale and Equipment' and its obligations are conditioned on describing a design space. This register expressly claims no design space, so measuring itself against that clause was self-flagellation against a rule that does not apply. The substance of the finding survives the re-anchoring unchanged, which is why the row stays not_knowable: nearly every parameter here is scale-DEPENDENT, and two failures are already visible - a 15 minute anneal that becomes of order 150 minutes at 1000 L purely from the cube-root area law (CPL-006), and a turndown justified for a whole slice by a shear claim whose sign was backwards. THE CAPABILITY EXISTS AND IS USED ONCE: the evaporator's turndown floor is a minimum wetting rate in kg per metre per second (ENV-017), an intensive quantity that survives a change of scale. So this is a gap in coverage, not in method (Q-068).

Both figures are carried as facts with a source (P-LIG-ANNEAL-T, P-LIG-ANNEAL-HOLD) and no range is claimed, because nothing in the record varies them. What is NOT claimed as a point is the DUTY at any other scale, which is a separate row of this checklist (IN-016) and an open question (Q-065).
